subject: Pollination Contract Request for Wenatchee Family Orchards
body_text:
Hi there!  

I hope this message finds you well! We’re looking to finalize our pollination needs for the upcoming blueberry bloom at Wenatchee Family Orchards. Last year, we used 24 hives for Block A, and we’d like to maintain that same count this season. Ideally, we’d want the hives delivered around April 15 and would appreciate a split delivery if possible to accommodate blooming times.  

Could you please send over a clear contract outlining the terms? Thanks for your help!  

Best,  
Carla Collins

subject: Request for Pollination Contract Details
body_text:
Hi there,  

I hope you’re doing well! We are looking to secure a pollination contract for our blueberry fields at Goldenridge Fruit Co. this upcoming season. We would like to request 30 hives, delivered for the blueberry bloom period, ideally starting around March 15th. If possible, could we arrange for a split delivery with half the hives arriving a week before the bloom?  

Please let me know if you can accommodate this request or if you need any more details. Thanks, and I look forward to hearing from you soon!  

Best,  
Kylie Williams

subject: Pollination Services Request for Blue Ridge Family Orchards
body_text:
Hello there, 

I hope this message finds you well! I’m reaching out to discuss our upcoming pollination needs for our various crops at Blue Ridge Family Orchards. We’re expanding this year and will require your services across multiple sites. Specifically, we’ll need 60 hives for our almond segment starting March 15 for a two-week period, followed by 40 hives for our apple orchards starting April 10. 

Additionally, we might want to look into restructuring our contract for a more flexible schedule this season, as we anticipate needing extra hives for our cherry blossoms in late May, depending on the bloom. Could you provide insights on hive availability for these dates? 

Let’s also discuss the possibility of securing a long-term plan since we are looking to streamline our operations in the upcoming seasons. 

Looking forward to your prompt response!

Best,  
Bruce Collier
